units.summary: Adds committedAppendID, which returns the last issued append ID when no appenders are open, and otherwise the lowest open append ID minus one. compactHeadViewLocked captures this value as the watermark that decides which series can be evicted, so a wrong value here could evict a series whose newest sample is in neither a block nor the head.
units.headline: New committedAppendID watermark: lowest open appendID minus one
units.reason: New logic that sets the eviction watermark in selected/stale-series compaction; an error here can lose data.
focus: Check that appendsOpenList stays sorted by ID (newAppendID inserts at the tail), so .next really is the lowest open ID
Check that closeAppend runs only after the appender's samples are written to memSeries, so ID <= watermark means the samples are visible to the block writer
When isolation is disabled this returns 0; confirm hasAppendIDAbove handles that and callers really have no concurrent writes, as the evictor doc requires

units.summary: New table of subtests covering committedAppendID: isolation disabled, no appenders, all appenders closed, one or several open appenders, and an open read. The expected values match the sentinel-ring behavior of newAppendID and closeAppend.
units.headline: Tests committedAppendID with open, closed and disabled appenders
units.reason: Test-only addition; it cannot change production behavior.
